endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve paginated list of factory complaints with filtering by date range, status, region, branch, area.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves complaints data from DB filtered by date range, status, location. Returns paginated list with regional filters.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid JWT token. User must exist in system.
business_logic.side_effects: Fetches region, branch, area options for UI filters

endpoints.name: GetBranch
endpoints.business_purpose: Fetch branches for a specific region.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves branches associated with a region ID from database.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. Valid region_id > 0.

endpoints.name: CreateObservationReport
endpoints.business_purpose: Create or update an observation report with optional file uploads to Google Drive.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates new or updates existing observation report. Processes JSON data, manages Google Drive file uploads, updates complaint status.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. If updating, observation report must exist. If cmsid provided, complaints header must exist.
business_logic.validations: Token validation, valid JSON in obs_data, files validation
business_logic.side_effects: Files uploaded to Google Drive. Complaint status updated to 'QC Inspection report received/ uploaded'. Audit log created.

idempotency.notes: File uploads to Google Drive are not idempotent. Multiple calls create multiple files.

endpoints.name: GetFactoryComplaintById
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve complete complaint details including header, details, factory visits, observations, credit notes, and files.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves complaint header, related details, factory visits, observation reports, credit notes, and associated files (images, documents, videos).
business_logic.preconditions: Valid complaint ID > 0. Complaint header must exist.
business_logic.side_effects: Fetches related files from DB. Maps to DTOs.

endpoints.name: GetAllFactories
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve paginated list of factories with optional filtering by date and search text.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves paginated factory list with optional date range and text search filters.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid JWT token.

endpoints.name: GetFactoryById
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve single factory details by ID.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves factory record by ID from database.
business_logic.preconditions: Factory ID > 0. Factory must exist.

endpoints.name: CreateFactory
endpoints.business_purpose: Create a new factory record with name, description, address, and phone number.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates new factory record. Validates factory name uniqueness. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Factory name required and must be unique.
business_logic.validations: ModelState valid. Factory name non-empty and unique.
business_logic.side_effects: Audit log created. User tracked in context.

idempotency.notes: Name uniqueness check means repeated calls fail. Recommend idempotency key on client.

endpoints.name: UpdateFactory
endpoints.business_purpose: Update existing factory details (name, description, address, phone).

business_logic.operation_summary: Updates existing factory record. Validates name uniqueness (excluding current ID). Creates audit log with old/new values.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Factory ID > 0. Factory must exist. At least one field must be provided.
business_logic.validations: Factory ID > 0. Factory exists. Factory name unique (excluding current). At least one field provided.
business_logic.side_effects: Audit log created with old and new values.

idempotency.notes: Name uniqueness check per ID reduces risk. Audit log tracks changes.

endpoints.name: DeleteFactory
endpoints.business_purpose: Delete (soft delete) a factory record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Soft deletes factory record by setting is_deleted flag. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Factory ID > 0. Factory must exist.
business_logic.side_effects: Audit log created. Factory marked as deleted.

idempotency.notes: Repeated DELETE calls fail once deleted. Audit log needed for idempotency detection.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve paginated list of factory direct dispatch records (indent orders).

business_logic.operation_summary: Fetches direct dispatch records filtered by search text with pagination.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User must exist.

endpoints.name: GetFactoryDirectDispatchById
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve detailed direct dispatch record (indent) by ID with product and item details.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves indent header with product-wise and item-wise details.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Indent ID > 0. Indent must exist.
business_logic.side_effects: Maps indent to DTO. Fetches actions.

endpoints.name: CreateIndent
endpoints.business_purpose: Create direct dispatch indent with products, auto-approve, auto-dispatch, update stock.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates indent, auto-approves by branch and credit, marks dispatched, updates product stock for each line item.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Dealer exists. Products exist with valid grade/thickness/size. Branch exists for dealer area.
business_logic.validations: Token validation. Dealer valid. Product details valid. Quantity/Weight > 0.
business_logic.side_effects: Inventory stock updated. Indent marked dispatched. Multiple DB writes.

idempotency.notes: Stock updates non-idempotent. Multiple calls decrement stock multiple times.

endpoints.name: DeleteIndent
endpoints.business_purpose: Delete (soft delete) direct dispatch indent record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Soft deletes indent record. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Indent ID > 0. Indent must exist.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve paginated list of factory operations details with optional filtering.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves factory ops details with date range and text filtering.
business_logic.preconditions: UNKNOWN - NOT DETERMINED FROM SOURCE

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.business_purpose: Create factory operations detail record with production metrics (temperature, pressure, load/unload times, quality details).

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates factory ops detail record. Checks for duplicates on product + grade + size + thickness + load.
business_logic.preconditions: ModelState valid. No duplicate exists for product+grade+size+thickness+load.

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check prevents re-creation. Multiple calls fail on second attempt.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.business_purpose: Update factory operations detail record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Updates factory ops detail record. Checks for duplicate excluding current ID.
business_logic.preconditions: ID > 0. No duplicate exists for product+grade+size+thickness+load (excluding current ID).

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check per ID reduces risk.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve factory production data with summary cards (total indents, dealers, areas) and pagination.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves production data with summary metrics (total indents, distinct dealers, distinct areas). Returns paginated results with cards.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

endpoints.name: PrintAction
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve indent records for printing with consent/consolidated form flags.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves indents by IDs with product details and approval info for printing.
business_logic.preconditions: Indent IDs provided. Indents must exist.

endpoints.name: GetAllFactorySections
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve paginated list of factory sections with optional date range and search filtering.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves factory section records with filtering and pagination.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

endpoints.name: CreateFactorySection
endpoints.business_purpose: Create a new factory section record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates factory section record. Requires user authentication.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

idempotency.notes: UNKNOWN - NO DUPLICATE CHECK FOUND IN SOURCE

endpoints.name: UpdateFactorySection
endpoints.business_purpose: Update existing factory section record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Updates factory section name and section field.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

idempotency.notes: UNKNOWN - NO DUPLICATE CHECK FOUND IN SOURCE

endpoints.name: DeleteFactorySection
endpoints.business_purpose: Delete factory section record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Soft deletes factory section by user ID and section ID.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

endpoints.name: SaveAllFactoryTradeConfigurations
endpoints.business_purpose: Create or update multiple factory trade value configurations (brand/percentage pairs).

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates or updates trade value configurations. For each brand: if exists, update percentage and modified_date; else create new.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Non-empty configurations list.

idempotency.notes: Idempotent for updates. Multiple calls update same records.

endpoints.name: GetProducts
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve list of products for trade value configuration with existing brands and unassigned products.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves all configured brands with their percentage values, plus unconfigured products with 0 value.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve factory trading margin report with filters for region, branch, dealer, product, factory and date range. Returns summary cards and paginated data.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves trading margin report with dynamic date ranges (this_month, last_month, last_60_days, last_180_days). Returns cards (total orders, discounts, factory amount, margin) and paginated data with filter options.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.
business_logic.side_effects: Fetches filter options (regions, branches, dealers, products, factories).

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve paginated list of factory units with optional filtering.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves factory units with date range and text search filtering, with pagination and actions.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

endpoints.name: GetFactoryUnitById
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve single factory unit details by ID.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves factory unit record with created_by user info and created_date.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Unit ID > 0. Unit must exist.

endpoints.name: CreateFactoryUnit
endpoints.business_purpose: Create a new factory unit with name.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates factory unit. Validates unit name non-empty. Checks for duplicate unit names.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Unit name non-empty and unique.
business_logic.validations: Token validation. Unit name non-empty. No duplicate exists.
business_logic.side_effects: New unit created with created_by and created_date.

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check prevents re-creation. Second call fails.

endpoints.name: UpdateFactoryUnit
endpoints.business_purpose: Update existing factory unit name.

business_logic.operation_summary: Updates factory unit name. Checks for duplicate excluding current ID.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. ID > 0. Unit exists. Unit name non-empty. No duplicate (excluding current ID).
business_logic.validations: Token validation. ID > 0. Unit exists. Unit name provided. Duplicate check (excluding current ID).
business_logic.side_effects: Unit updated with modified_by and modified_date.

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check per ID reduces risk.

endpoints.name: DeleteFactoryUnit
endpoints.business_purpose: Delete factory unit record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Soft deletes factory unit. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. ID > 0. Unit must exist.
business_logic.side_effects: Audit log created. Unit marked deleted.

endpoints.name: GetAllFactoryMappings
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve paginated list of factory-to-user mappings.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves factory mappings with pagination and optional text filtering.
business_logic.preconditions: UNKNOWN - NO EXPLICIT PRECONDITIONS IN SOURCE
business_logic.validations: UNKNOWN - NO EXPLICIT VALIDATIONS IN SOURCE

endpoints.name: CreateFactoryMapping
endpoints.business_purpose: Create factory mappings for a user. Replaces existing mappings for the user with new factory IDs.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates new factory mappings for user. First deletes all existing mappings for the user, then creates new ones for each factory ID.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User (creator) exists. Selected user exists. At least one factory ID provided. Factories must exist.
business_logic.validations: Token validation. selecteduserId > 0. User exists. At least one factory ID. Factories exist.
business_logic.side_effects: Existing mappings deleted. New mappings created. Audit log created for each successful mapping.

idempotency.notes: Deletes and recreates mappings. Multiple calls delete intermediate mappings.

endpoints.name: UpdateFactoryMapping
endpoints.business_purpose: Update factory mappings by mapping ID.

business_logic.operation_summary: Updates factory mapping record. Validates mapping exists. Updates for each factory in request.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User (creator) exists. mappingId > 0. Mapping exists. At least one factory ID provided.
business_logic.validations: Token validation. mappingId > 0. Mapping exists. At least one factory ID.
business_logic.side_effects: Mapping updated per factory. Audit log created for successful updates.

idempotency.notes: Updates per factory. Audit log tracks changes.

endpoints.name: DeleteFactoryMapping
endpoints.business_purpose: Delete a factory mapping record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Soft deletes factory mapping record. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User (creator) exists. mappingId > 0. Mapping must exist.

endpoints.name: GetFactoriesByUser
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve list of factories assigned to a specific user.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves factories mapped to a user with ID and name.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve paginated list of financial quarters with optional search text filtering.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves financial quarters with pagination and optional text search.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

endpoints.name: GetFinancialQuarterById
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve single financial quarter details by ID.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves financial quarter with associated financial year details.
business_logic.preconditions: ID > 0. Quarter must exist.

endpoints.name: CreateFinancialQuarter
endpoints.business_purpose: Create a new financial quarter with name, financial year ID, and date range.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates financial quarter. Validates quarter name non-empty and unique. Fetches financial year by ID.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Quarter name non-empty and unique. Financial year exists.
business_logic.validations: Token validation. ModelState valid. Quarter name non-empty. No duplicate quarter name.

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check prevents re-creation. Second call fails.

endpoints.name: UpdateFinancialQuarter
endpoints.business_purpose: Update existing financial quarter details.

business_logic.operation_summary: Updates financial quarter. Checks for duplicate quarter name excluding current ID.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. ID > 0. Quarter exists. No duplicate (excluding current ID).
business_logic.validations: Token validation. ID > 0. Quarter exists. No duplicate quarter name (excluding current).
business_logic.side_effects: Quarter updated. Audit log created with old/new values.

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check per ID reduces risk.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.business_purpose: Delete financial quarter record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Soft deletes financial quarter. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. ID > 0. Quarter must exist.
business_logic.side_effects: Quarter marked deleted. Audit log created.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve paginated list of financial years with optional search text filtering.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves financial years with pagination and optional text search.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentFinancialYear
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve current financial year configuration.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves the current financial year. Returns null if none configured.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists.

endpoints.name: GetFinancialYearById
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve single financial year details by ID.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves financial year record by ID.
business_logic.preconditions: ID > 0. Year must exist.

endpoints.name: CreateFinancialYear
endpoints.business_purpose: Create a new financial year with name and date range.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates financial year. Validates name non-empty and unique.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Year name non-empty and unique.
business_logic.validations: Token validation. ModelState valid. Year name non-empty. No duplicate year name.

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check prevents re-creation. Second call fails.

endpoints.name: UpdateFinancialYear
endpoints.business_purpose: Update existing financial year details.

business_logic.operation_summary: Updates financial year. Checks for duplicate year name excluding current ID.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. ID > 0. Year exists. No duplicate (excluding current ID).
business_logic.validations: Token validation. ID > 0. Year exists. No duplicate year name (excluding current).
business_logic.side_effects: Year updated. Audit log created with old/new values.

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check per ID reduces risk.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.business_purpose: Delete financial year record.

business_logic.operation_summary: Soft deletes financial year. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. ID > 0. Year must exist.
business_logic.side_effects: Year marked deleted. Audit log created.
